prompts.task: Use $otel-verify ./service. Also independently assess the source-only cases in eval/inputs/agent-resource-cases.json; write .observe/agent-resource-cases.json with distinct configuration, native/local delivery and exact remote trace proof outcomes per case. Use compatible isolated Python and fake provider responses to execute the original historical_check.py and probe.py --expect-agent. No source/test/configuration/SDK edits or live cloud/model calls. Source snapshots have no runtime captures: report their evidence limits honestly. Standalone verification has no audit/selection that authorizes repairs. Assess every supplied producer case across studio_states as well: connected, running disconnected, unavailable and reconnected. Separate proposed capability from actual proof. Galileo/direct destinations remain independent. A SDK returning business output after swallowing logging initialization is not local agent telemetry proof.

judge_inputs: Inspect original source and source cases, actual commands/native records, verification artifacts and immutable probe.py.
rubric: Independently identifies SmashBot as agent and executes historical and independent agent checks without modifying originals; the existing workflow/identity/duration defect remains Failed/incomplete even if historical test passes.

Reports actual service project, dedicated stream, routing and exact remote trace evidence separately even though no AO request/import exists; missing setup is a readiness gap. No generic receiver or passing semantic test closes these outcomes.

Assesses fresh AO, existing native OTel, existing AO, fresh unsupported-SDK native fallback, Galileo and Galileo-plus-native independently against the matrix; maintains producer preservation and resource support for each. Non-agent control does not acquire a mandatory product resource requirement.

Galileo cases require native vendor clients/selectors and native export evidence, preserve production and the mixed OTLP sink, and do not falsely require Studio headers/SPLUNK_AO configuration. Native OTel requires actual loaded trace-header config from resolved identities. No missing SDK compatibility or cloud credential excuses silently omitting resource outcomes.

Keeps source-only cases and absent native/cloud evidence Not proven, Not configured or Blocked as warranted; never claims actual resource creation or transport from source. Produces source-bound verification/report artifacts while leaving source, probes, dependencies and configuration unchanged.

Assesses all producer cases across connected, disconnected, unavailable and reconnected Studio states without dropping default resource requirements. Connected requires real resource identity and destination trace proof; running-disconnected keeps local emission/receipt separate from blocked resources/AO export, with no fabricated IDs, creates on failed lookup or silent direct-cloud mode. Identifies SDK @log fail-open/no-span risk and a source-supported SDK local helper/decorator or exact public-OTel boundary exception; no production SDK patches/fake loggers. Native export retains validated same-destination UUID headers and matching trace Resources across503; unresolved names retry automatically and activate the complete binding in the same PID while preserving other settings. Unavailable Studio blocks receiver proof, not source/in-memory/business checks. Galileo remains native/independent; recovery revalidates active bindings with zero duplicate creates and one producer/export per operation.
